title: niphobolus percussus
intro: Niphobolus percussus, commonly known as Polypodium percussum, is a type of fern plant native to various parts of the world, particularly in Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Niphobolus percussus include its ability to act as an anti-hemorrhagic agent, helping to stop bleeding and promote wound healing, as well as its diuretic properties, which can aid in reducing fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of Niphobolus percussus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
